about_the_game:
"Every cut sings such sweet sorrow!" 

- Lucius the Eternal

Revel in battle’s ecstasy by collecting the Emperor’s Children! The gene-sons of Fulgrim join Warpforge as a new collectable faction, ready to bring new delights to their patron god… and themselves. Feel the rush of battle and overstimulate your senses by commanding one of the most depraved factions to join the battlefield yet!

Get a head start with this starter bundle, which includes:

  • A new Legendary Warlord: Lucius the Eternal

  • 10 Emperor’s Children booster packs: each contains 5 cards from this new faction, with a guaranteed rare or better card in each booster pack

  • An exclusive Cosmetic Item: 'Lucius the Eternal' avatar

This DLC offers the best way to kick-start your Emperor’s Children collection. Will you fight to sate Slaanesh’s desires?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, including infrequent strong language, depictions of violence and gore, and online interaction between players.
